Fe.name: Iron (Fe)
Fe.role: Basaltic crust, hematite & ferric oxides (high in Northern Lowlands / Acidalia)

H2O.name: Water / Hydrogen (H₂O)
H2O.role: Hydrated sulfates, phyllosilicates & subsurface ground ice (Arabia, Utopia, Poles)

Si.name: Silicon (Si)
Si.role: Silicate crust, silica sinter & andesitic volcanics

S.name: Sulfur (S)
S.role: Evaporite sulfate beds & volcanic outgassing (Meridiani, Valles Marineris, Tharsis)

Cl.name: Chlorine (Cl)
Cl.role: Perchlorates, halite evaporites & aqueous brine deposits (Medusae Fossae, Tharsis)

K.name: Potassium (K)
K.role: Incompatible crustal element & K-feldspar / illite clays

Th.name: Thorium (Th)
Th.role: Natural radiogenic heat tracer & evolved crustal igneous provinces

Al.name: Aluminum (Al)
Al.role: Plagioclase feldspar & Al-smectite / kaolinite clay horizons

Ca.name: Calcium (Ca)
Ca.role: Pyroxene basalt, gypsum sulfates & carbonate lake margins

DCI.name: Dust Cover Index (DCI)
DCI.role: MGS TES silicate dust emissivity (low = thick dust mantle; high = dust-free bedrock)
